en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-263 Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Taleqani (ra) narrated that Abdul Aziz ibn Yahya quoted Muhammad ibn Zakariya, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Ammarat, on the authority of his father that he had heard Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s.) say: “
There were three who used to ascribe lies to Messenger of Allah (sw): Abu Hurayrah, Anas ibn Malik, and a woman.”
